description: This file is a shell script used for testing git cvsimport handling of branches and tags within a specific repository. It sets up a test environment, runs various tests to verify branch and tag structures, and checks the import process.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a test repository for CVS import tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a given condition.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares the branch tree against an expected structure.

calls: test_expect_success PERL 'import module' 'git cvsimport -C module-git module'
